hooks.perkRerollDie: Once per attack with the named skill, re-roll up to n dice of one colour (blank results only when blankOnly).
hooks.perkSkillGrantIfMissing: If the model has no such skill, it gains the skill at the given value.
hooks.perkHealthBonus: Adds n to the model's Health.
hooks.perkConcentratedFire: Bonus to the listed skills when shooting the same target as the previous Action; once per activation.
hooks.perkRadiationHeals: Radiation damage heals this model instead of hurting it.
hooks.perkMedic: Stimpak removes 1 extra damage and RadAway removes 1 extra radiation.
hooks.perkChemist: The last (right-most) column of a Chem's effect lasts one more activation.
hooks.perkSneak: Movement and Melee attacks by this model are Reaction triggers only inside one range ruler.
hooks.perkActionBoy: At activation roll a blue die; on the stated icon gain 1 AP. Not usable together with V.A.T.S.
hooks.perkBlitz: One Melee attack per activation may be made at the stated ruler colour.
hooks.perkRerollAddiction: Re-roll an addiction roll once per battle.
hooks.perkIgnoreFoodRadiation: Ignore the radiation that food and drink would give.
hooks.perkMovingTarget: After spending both Actions on movement, ranged attacks against the model take a penalty until a stated trigger ends it.
hooks.perkHuntsman: Before a rifle shot, replace the weapon's damage with a fixed 1 damage plus an extra special.
hooks.perkPackLeader: Grants the Dog Handler ability, or one more controlled dog; may be stacked.
hooks.perkBloodyMess: On removing an enemy, flip Luck; on a hit, up to 2 nearby enemies take a penalty until after their next action.
hooks.perkEntangle: When engaged, force a disengaging enemy into an opposed AGI test (once per activation).
hooks.perkResistCondition: Resistant to the listed conditions: flip Luck each time one would be gained, ignore on a hit.
hooks.perkImpatient: Once per activation take 1 damage to gain 1 AP.
hooks.perkIgnoreCover: When shooting ignore n items of cover.
hooks.perkLightStep: When a mine would trigger from this model's movement, flip Luck; on a hit it does not trigger.
hooks.perkStartReaction: Start the battle with n Reaction markers.
hooks.perkFinesse: Start with Critical tokens on the card; flip one when gaining a Critical Point and add it to the weapon on a hit.
hooks.perkHackRobot: Expertise: opposed Computers test against a Robot's INT while engaged; success hacks it.
hooks.perkIrresponsible: May take 1 damage instead of gaining the Stun condition.
hooks.perkCollaborative: A friendly shot into Close Combat hits the intended target, not a random one.
hooks.perkPyromaniac: If an attack could have set a target on fire but did not, roll a blue die; on the stated icon apply Fire.
hooks.perkCompanion: Pick a Companion at set-up; activating either while the other is in range and LoS gives a free effect die.
hooks.perkTravelLight: Move ruler one colour longer unless the model wears armor or clothing cards or has any armor rating of 3+.
hooks.perkShotgunDevotee: No Quick Action penalty for shots with weapons that have Shotgun in the name.
hooks.perkWeaponHandling: Weapon STR requirements are n lower for this model.
hooks.perkChosenDisciple: On removing an enemy with an attack the model gains 1 Quick Action Point.
hooks.perkNerdRage: At Health 1-2, once per battle gain AP, strong armor and extra Melee dice.
hooks.perkMysteriousStranger: On a V.A.T.S. icon, summon the Stranger to make an automatic attack (tier I-III changes range, dice and delay).
hooks.perkPainTrain: While wearing Power Armor, a Charge may swap its bonus tokens for an immediate physical-damage roll.
hooks.perkBasher: A ranged weapon used in Close Combat does not give the target extra armor.
hooks.noOtherLos: Condition: no enemy other than the target has Line of Sight to the model.
hooks.noFriendlyWithinPresence: Condition: no friendly model (dogs excluded) is inside the model's Presence ruler.
hooks.perkHitTheDeckArea: Condition: the damage comes from an area effect.
hooks.dogAttack: Condition: the attacker is a dog.
hooks.perkResistInjury: Resistant to injured-arm and injured-leg conditions: flip Luck each time one would be gained, ignore on a hit.

rulings: RULING: Perk icon readings | icon-only text read by comparing cards: cog = AP, burst = 1 damage, bandage cone = arm, sock = leg, clover = Luck flip, blast icon on the V.A.T.S. die (Mysterious Stranger), Quick Thinking's rings = a Reaction marker | the cards print icons without captions | Unsourced | PERKS p21, p27, p28

RULING: Robotics Expert and Creature Trainer | settlement-wide, 4 caps each, enabling the Robot and Creature Workbench/Pen and Mods; no card face is in a local PDF | cost from the cost sheet, effect from the Settlement Sheet requirement | Unsourced | SHEET p1; COST PERKS
RULING: Shotgun Devotee name | the card says Shotgun Devotee, the cost sheet lists Shotgun Surgeon at 6 caps | the same Wave 5 card under two names | Unsourced | PERKS p15; COST PERKS
RULING: Pack Leader exclusions | the three type icons read as Dog, Creature and Robot | icons uncaptioned | Unsourced | PERKS p24

RULING: Faction-locked Perks | Chosen Disciple, Pack Alpha and Ace Operator carry requires.faction as a plain id ('disciples', 'pack', 'operators') until the M7 factions exist | their factions are not in data/1e/factions yet | Unsourced | PERKS p3

RULING: Perk scope | every Perk on the Wave 1-9 card sheets plus the two settlement-wide Perks named by the Settlement Sheet; Perks that belong to Leader, Command or Program card sets in the cost sheet (Brawler, Bodyguard, Command: *, Program: *, Animal Friend, ...) are not Perk cards and are not entered | the perk_cards_w9 PDF is the Perk card list | Confirmed | PERKS; COST PERKS

records.name: Gun Nut (Rifle)
records.text: The settlement may fit Rifle Mods, one per weapon card, once it holds them. Brings one free Weapons Workbench.

records.name: Gun Nut (Pistol)
records.text: The settlement may fit Pistol Mods, one per weapon card, once it holds them. Brings one free Weapons Workbench.

records.name: Blacksmith
records.text: The settlement may fit Melee Mods, one per weapon card, once it holds them. Brings one free Weapons Workbench.

records.name: Armorer
records.text: The settlement may fit armor Mods (and Power Armor Mods), one per card, once it holds them. Brings one free Armor Workbench, never a Power Armor Station.

records.name: Local Leader
records.text: Unlocks the advanced settlement Structures that ask for a Local Leader.

records.name: Nerd Rage
records.text: When the model is down to 1 or 2 Health it may, once per battle, gain 1 AP, 1 strong armor and an extra black die on Melee attacks.

records.name: Mysterious Stranger
records.text: When the V.A.T.S. roll shows the blast icon, a ghostly Stranger hits your nearest unengaged enemy in line of sight for 2 physical damage plus a black die; your choice on a tie. Optional.

records.name: Gun Nut (Heavy)
records.text: The settlement may fit Heavy weapon Mods, one per weapon card, once it holds them. Brings one free Weapons Workbench.

records.name: Hacker
records.text: +2 to Computers; a model with no Computers skill gets it at 2.

records.name: Concentrated Fire
records.text: Shooting the same target as your previous Action: +2 to the shot, once per activation (Pistol, Rifle or Heavy).

records.name: Toughness
records.text: +1 physical armor.

records.name: Rad Resistant
records.text: +1 radiation armor.

records.name: Ghoulish
records.text: Radiation heals this model instead of harming it.

records.name: Medic
records.text: Stimpaks heal 1 extra damage and RadAway removes 1 extra radiation.

records.name: Chemist
records.text: The last column of any Chem effect lasts one more activation.

records.name: Sneak
records.text: Moving and Melee attacks only count as Reaction triggers within one range ruler.

records.name: Action Boy / Girl
records.text: At activation roll a blue die and gain 1 AP on a star. Not usable alongside V.A.T.S. in the same activation.

records.name: Rifleman
records.text: Once per Rifle attack, re-roll 1 blank black die.

records.name: Life Giver
records.text: +1 Health.

records.name: Big Leagues
records.text: Once per Melee attack, re-roll 1 blank black die.

records.name: Steady Aim
records.text: Once per Pistol or Rifle attack, re-roll 1 green die.

records.name: Refractor
records.text: +1 energy armor.

records.name: Basher
records.text: Firing a ranged weapon in Close Combat does not hand the target the usual extra armor (the -2 to the skill still applies).

records.name: Pain Train
records.text: In Power Armor, a Charge may skip the Charge Bonus tokens and instead roll 1 black die at once; the target resolves damage icons as physical damage with the normal armor roll.
records.source: PERKS p28; COST PERKS; ERR p.19

records.name: Locksmith
records.text: +2 to Lockpick; a model with no Lockpick skill gets it at 2.

records.name: Ninja
records.text: When nobody except the target can see the model, long-range shots add 1 green die.

records.name: Blitz
records.text: One Melee attack per activation can be made at Orange range.

records.name: Heavy Gunner
records.text: Once per Heavy attack, re-roll 1 blank black die.

records.name: Lone Wanderer
records.text: With no friendly model (dogs excepted) inside Presence: +1 armor of every type, +1 yellow die on Rifle and Pistol attacks and +2 Health.

records.name: Attack Dog
records.text: The dog's attacks gain a bonus special: spend a bottle icon to injure a leg.

records.name: Chem Resistant
records.text: Re-roll an addiction roll, once per battle.

records.name: Gunslinger
records.text: Once per Pistol attack, re-roll 1 blank black die.

records.name: Mysterious Stranger II
records.text: A V.A.T.S. star or blast icon lets you place the Stranger up to Red away; he auto-hits any model in his line of sight for 2 physical damage plus black and yellow dice, then leaves. One Stranger Perk per activation.
records.source: PERKS p24; COST PERKS; ERR p.19

records.name: Mysterious Stranger III
records.text: As tier II, but when the Stranger appears you choose: attack straight away, or leave a marker beside him and attack later with a Reaction. He goes after the attack or when anything damages him.
records.source: PERKS p24; COST PERKS; ERR p.19

records.name: Lead Belly
records.text: Ignore the radiation from food and drink.

records.name: Moving Target
records.text: After using both normal Actions on moving or charging, ranged attacks against you take -2 until your next activation, or until you become engaged, react, get pushed back or take damage.

records.name: Huntsman
records.text: Before a Rifle shot you may swap its damage for 1 damage of the weapon's usual type (never radiation) with a blue-die star that injures a leg.

records.name: Demolition Expert
records.text: Once per attack with a grenade or explosive, re-roll 1 blank black die.

records.name: Pack Leader
records.text: The model gains the Dog Handler ability (a dog it controls can use Search with the handler's PER, and goes Heroic when the handler is). If it already has it, it controls one more dog. Can be taken more than once.

records.name: Bloody Mess
records.text: When your attack removes an enemy, flip Luck; on a hit up to 2 enemies within Yellow and in line of sight of the casualty take -2 until after their next action.

records.name: Entangle
records.text: When engaged you may force a disengaging enemy into an opposed AGI test: win and it cannot disengage this turn; lose and it leaves without a free attack. Once per activation.

records.name: Stun Resistant
records.text: Resistant to the Stun condition.

records.name: Impatient
records.text: Once per activation, take 1 damage to gain 1 AP.

records.name: Penetrator
records.text: Shooting ignores 1 item of cover.

records.name: Nuclear Physicist
records.text: Add 1 black die to attacks with a weapon that deals radiation damage.

records.name: Light Step
records.text: When this model's movement would set off a mine, flip Luck; on a hit that move does not trigger it.

records.name: Quick Thinking
records.text: Start the battle holding a Reaction marker.

records.name: Finesse
records.text: Start with 3 Critical tokens on the card. When a dice icon gives a Critical Point you may flip one; on a hit it goes onto the weapon, otherwise it stays on the card.

records.name: Hack Robot
records.text: While engaged with an enemy Robot, use Expertise for an opposed Computers test against its INT. Win: the Robot gains two conditions and cannot be hacked again. Lose: the hacker gains one and the Robot may move Orange.

records.name: Fire Resistant
records.text: Resistant to the Fire condition.

records.name: Irresponsible
records.text: May take 1 damage instead of gaining the Stun condition.

records.name: Collaborative
records.text: When a friendly shot goes into your Close Combat, it hits the target the shooter meant instead of a random one.

records.name: Strong Constitution
records.text: Resistant to the Poison condition.

records.name: Pyromaniac
records.text: If an attack could have set a target on fire and did not, roll a blue die; a star lights the fire after all.

records.name: Companion
records.text: Pick a Companion at set-up. Activating either of you while the other is in range and line of sight gives a free effect die (black, yellow or green) if you hold none. If the Companion is removed, take -2 for the rest of the battle. Unique models only.

records.name: Adamantium Skeleton
records.text: Resistant to injured-arm and injured-leg; each time one would be gained, flip Luck and skip it on a hit.

records.name: Travel Light
records.text: Move one ruler colour longer, unless wearing armor or clothing cards or any armor rating is 3 or more.

records.name: Hit the Deck
records.text: +1 physical and energy armor against area-effect damage only.

records.name: Shotgun Devotee
records.text: No penalty on Quick Action shots with a weapon that has Shotgun in its name.
records.source: PERKS p15; COST PERKS (listed as Shotgun Surgeon)

records.name: Weapon Handling
records.text: Weapon STR requirements are 2 lower for this model.

records.name: Chosen Disciple
records.text: When this model removes an enemy with an attack, it gains 1 Quick Action Point. Disciples only (or the Sole Survivor in a Disciples force).

records.name: Pack Alpha
records.text: +1 on every armor value and +1 black die on every Melee combat action. Pack models only (or the Sole Survivor in a Pack force).

records.name: Ace Operator
records.text: +1 black die on every action with a silenced Pistol or Rifle weapon. Operators only (or the Sole Survivor in an Operator force).

records.name: Local Leader II
records.text: Unlocks the top-tier settlement Structures that ask for Local Leader II. Printed on the same card as Local Leader.

records.name: Robotics Expert
records.text: Lets the settlement build a Robot Workbench and fit Robot Mods. Card text not in any local source; read from the Settlement Sheet's requirement.
records.source: SHEET p1; COST PERKS; FCL p5

records.name: Creature Trainer
records.text: Lets the settlement build a Creature Pen and fit Creature Mods. Card text not in any local source; read from the Settlement Sheet's requirement.
records.source: SHEET p1; COST PERKS; FCL p8
